message.content:
An editorial illustration features a man in a black suit, white shirt, and sunglasses reclining in a bathtub. His bare feet extend over the left edge, and his right hand holds a lit cigar emitting a long trail of grey smoke. The bathtub sits elevated above a cityscape of miniature rectangular and pointed skyscrapers. Water overflows from the tub's rim, flooding the small buildings below with reddish-brown liquid. The background consists of light green tiled walls.

Large red text reads "TEMPO" across the top, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. Smaller black text at the top reads "Macet Penuntasan Korupsi Lembaga Pembiayaan Ekspor H.70" and "BUMN Karya di Ambang Bangkrut H.78". Central black text states "BOHIR PERUSAK PUNCAK" above a paragraph starting with "Alih fungsi lahan secara ugal-ugalan di Puncak, Bogor...". A barcode and "17-23 MARET 2024" are visible on the bottom left. The man's suit is smooth and dark, while the tub is white and rounded. The miniature buildings appear made of grey material, partially submerged in the dark water.
